morecloudlayers.config.title: More Cloud Layers
morecloudlayers.config.layerCount.toolti: Add cloud layers above the vanilla layer.
morecloudlayers.config.randomLayerPositi: Each layer is placed on a random slot instead of stacking sequentially, leaving gaps.
Each layer moves this much slower than the one before it.
morecloudlayers.config.sizeDropPercent.t: Each layer's cloud tiling shrinks by this much compared to the one before it.
morecloudlayers.config.randomTransparenc: Each layer gets a random opacity between 75% and 100%.
morecloudlayers.config.layerCullingEnabl: Removes a portion of each layer's cloud texture, thinning things out at high layer counts.
morecloudlayers.config.layerCullingPatte: Which shape gets removed from each layer's texture.
